name: icp-targeting-tiers
description: Define ICP differences across small business, mid-market, and enterprise — buying process, deal size, sales motion, tool stack, messaging by tier. Use when segmenting GTM by company size, designing tier-specific plays, or adapting messaging to buyer sophistication. Triggers on: "ICP tiers", "small business vs enterprise", "mid-market ICP", "segment by company size", "SMB vs enterprise sales", "how to sell to small business".
